title: Upstream-owned files stay structurally upstream-identical
rationale: We merge upstream/main regularly (conductor, threshold-gated). Restructuring a file that exists upstream (split/rename/delete) turns every upstream edit into a modify/delete conflict plus manual re-mapping — a permanent merge tax proportional to the file's upstream churn. server/tests.rs alone churns 112 commits/12w upstream (fabro-ab8e), so the fabro-90ae split would have been the worst-case tax.
